description: Header file defining structures, enums, and function prototypes for managing parallel checkout operations in a version control system.

methods.name: parallel_checkout_status
methods.description: Returns the current status of the parallel checkout process.

methods.name: get_parallel_checkout_configs
methods.description: Retrieves configuration parameters for parallel checkout, such as number of workers and threshold.

methods.name: init_parallel_checkout
methods.description: Initializes the parallel checkout process, setting it to accepting entries.

methods.name: enqueue_checkout
methods.description: Enqueues a cache entry for parallel checkout if eligible.

methods.name: pc_queue_size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the checkout queue.

methods.name: run_parallel_checkout
methods.description: Executes the queued checkout entries, either in parallel or sequentially based on threshold.

methods.name: write_pc_item
methods.description: Writes a parallel checkout item to the checkout state.
